title: Ride-hail apps carried 86% of NYC trips in Aug 2026

subtitles.share_trend: Uber's share fell 1.7 pts between Aug 2024 and Aug 2026, the biggest shift of any company; it dipped to 59% in Aug 2025

findings.question: Q1
findings.text: Ride-hail apps carried 86% of NYC trips in Aug 2026 (+1.7 pts on a year earlier), and their share of pickups rose in 231 of 256 zones

findings.question: Q2
findings.text: Congestion pricing had an estimated effect of −4.2% on trips touching the zone (weekly range −7.4% to −0.9%); by mode, ride-hail apps −8.1% and yellow cabs −7.8%, while green cabs, 0.2% of NYC trips, came out at +4.1%

findings.question: Q3
findings.text: For ride-hail trips touching the zone, congestion pricing had an estimated effect of +3.0% on fare per mile and −3.7% on the driver share of the base fare

findings.question: Q4
findings.text: Lyft had a bigger share of pickups than Uber in 1 zone in Aug 2026, the same as a year earlier

findings.question: Q5
findings.text: Drivers received 78% of ride-hail base fares in Aug 2026 (−0.3 pts on a year earlier): Uber 78% and Lyft 76%

findings.question: Q6
findings.text: Over the 12 weeks after the new minimum-pay rule of Aug 2025, which lowered the per-mile floor and raised the per-minute floor, ride-hail driver pay per minute with a passenger fell 0.9% and pay per mile fell 1.2% against the 12 weeks before, net of the same weeks of 2024; base fare per mile fell 2.2%

findings.question: Q7
findings.text: Riders paid a median $6.52/mile in Aug 2026; fares per mile varied most for Uber trips from Garment District, where the 90th percentile was 5.4× the 10th

findings.question: Q8
findings.text: Uber riders waited a median 4.3 min from request to pickup in Aug 2026, Lyft riders 4.5 min; the longest median wait was 9.8 min, for Uber riders in Breezy Point/Fort Tilden/Riis Beach

findings.question: Q9
findings.text: Uber carried 63% of trips to and from JFK and LaGuardia and to Newark in Aug 2026; the mean fare to Manhattan before tip was $106 from JFK and $75.52 from LaGuardia, and trips peaked at 2 pm

findings.question: Q10
findings.text: Yellow cabs carried more pickups than any other mode in 6 zones in Aug 2026, down from 9 a year earlier

findings.question: Q11
findings.text: Uber completed 43,600 trips that requested a wheelchair-accessible vehicle in Aug 2026 and Lyft 24,400, and 12% of Uber's trips and 6.4% of Lyft's trips ran in one; requests that went unfilled aren't in TLC's records

findings.question: Q12
findings.text: Uber and Lyft riders made 273,000 shared-ride requests in Aug 2026 (−50.9% on a year earlier), and 59% were matched; the most came from LaGuardia Airport

findings.question: Q13
findings.text: Riders tipped 4.3% of the base fare on Uber and 5.3% on Lyft in Aug 2026; card-only tips came to 22% of the fare on yellow cabs and 20% on green cabs

findings.question: Q14
findings.text: Trips were charged $11.5 million in congestion fees in Aug 2026 (+1.9% on a year earlier); Uber trips paid the most, $7.2 million

findings.question: Q15
findings.text: TLC reports that ride-hail vehicles made 1.74 trips/hour worked in Aug 2026, on the road 6.4 hours a day, with 85,800 drivers active
